prompts:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square ecommerce product photograph, one realistic slate/near-black Yupoong 6606 Retro Trucker cap on a warm ivory matte seamless backdrop, front three-quarter view with curved visor pointing slightly left, entire cap in frame with generous breathing room. Soft natural sidelight from upper left, tactile woven fabric, precise seams, mesh back visible on the right, subtle contact shadows. Product construction must be 6 panels, structured medium crown, hard buckram front, dark mesh rear panels, curved visor with 8 rows of matching stitching, snapback closure; not an unstructured dad hat. 
Reference image 1 is the EXACT OFF SHFT embroidery artwork to reproduce. Reference image 2 is the front placement and construction diagram ONLY. Reference image 3 is lighting/material mood ONLY; do not reproduce its cap shape, incorrect hands, collage, hoodie, trousers, packaging or other objects.
Embroider the reference1 official logo small across lower front at a believable 62.6 mm total width, about 30% of the cap front width. Bone #ECE5D3 letters/O ring, Sun #D29B3C two hands and pivot dot. Preserve exact wide letterforms and text "OFF SHFT", no I in SHFT. The clock O is the first O, never an extra symbol before OFF. Its upper hand points exactly at12; the other hand points diagonally down-right at5:00 (NOT straight down at6), hands separated from ring with fabric channels. Keep lettering at the reference proportion; the logo is not a huge badge. Shift wordmark slightly right so center cap seam falls in space between OFF and SHFT. Raised satin thread texture, tight clean edges, realistic modest stitch relief. Single cap only, no model, no tags, no packaging, no captions, no watermark, no other logos. Draft concept colour, not a supplier colour claim.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the first image with a surgical embroidery correction. Preserve the cap, shape, dark mesh rear, seams, visor, exact camera angle, fabric, warm ivory background, light and shadow. Preserve the overall small embroidery placement and width. Replace the embroidered wordmark with an accurate stitched rendering of reference2. It must read OFF SHFT in the supplied wide bold letterforms. MOST IMPORTANT: lower Sun/gold hand of the initial clock O must point noticeably diagonally DOWN-RIGHT at 5 o'clock, about 30 degrees clockwise from vertical-down. It should protrude from ring's LOWER-RIGHT at a diagonal, with a visible dark fabric gap before the hand begins. It must NOT be a straight downward vertical gold bar. The upper hand points 12. Bone O ring and Sun center dot. Correct all lettering to supplied logo proportions. Do not add text, objects, or branding.
products.visualReview: Full structured mesh-back trucker, correct phrase/variant, warm ground, frame intact. Clock lower hand points down-right; satin stitch and geometric proportions remain generated approximations.
